name: Sonsaku Hakufu
source: One of the main female protagonists and main heroines in the Koihime†Musou series, she is the crown princess of Go kingdom and the eldest daughter of the Son family. She holds the reputation of "Little Conquerer", due to her ambitious dream of unifying the land.
